milestone: V0.9 Product Runtime / Unified Goal API
progress: V0.9.1 Unified Goal API PASS; V0.9.2 Goal Query / Status / Events PASS; V0.9.3 Always-On Runtime PASS; V0.9.4 durable lifecycle controls implementation and tests committed
execution_step: Run full regression CI for durable lifecycle controls and recovery exclusion
execution_detail: GoalLifecycleService now exposes durable pause, cancel and explicit resume transitions above JsonGoalStore. ProductRuntime exposes the same controls. Paused and cancelled goals are explicitly mapped to RecoveryAction.NONE so background RecoveryDaemon scans cannot silently restart user-stopped work. Resume is allowed only from paused, preserves resume_cursor, appends RESUME_REQUESTED, and returns the goal to in_progress so the normal bounded recovery policy may continue it. Cancelled and completed goals fail closed for resume/pause/cancel operations where appropriate.
current_work: Verify lifecycle persistence, idempotency boundaries, explicit resume semantics, and background recovery exclusion across the complete regression suite.
next_step: If CI is green, mark V0.9.4 DONE and begin V0.9.5 Real Product E2E: instantiate ProductRuntime with real Research/Coding/Computer executors and prove submit -> query/events -> pause/resume boundary -> recovery -> GOAL_COMPLETE through the product surface.
finish_line: V0.9 completes when autonomous orchestration is exposed as a stable always-on product runtime with submission, query/status/events, lifecycle controls, and a real local product E2E.
user_action: None. Keep the V0.9 watcher open.
